recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the missing current-build statement without reviving obsolete DSTU1 iglist wording or changing the package-based IG model. No additional related Jira decision is needed for FHIR-18407 because it only supplies source-history context.
issue_request: FHIR-7788 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for a DSTU1 concern about what constitutes the normative profile or implementation-guide description and how to separate it from the rest of FHIR. The resolution said all representation forms are equally normative and that the publication form defines the set of files.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in svn revision 6819, represented in git by 36ec73fea49b49d1b4007a8ecdc79cc1752e3754, adding source/iglist.html text that implementation-guide representations generated from conformance resources are equally normative. QA commit 35568981225e4cb9d74984a9f6af59b523bc3c6e retained the explicit equal-representation wording.
additional_context: source/iglist.html was deleted in 2017 by 8b16115d880b33726d98fd973da248d688742494, so the original applied sentence no longer feeds the current build. Current active source has ImplementationGuide listed in source/fhir.ini and describes implementation guides as package-distributed combinations of computer-processible resources and human-readable documentation. Package documentation now covers the publication-form side of the original resolution. FHIR-18407 later added adjacent ImplementationGuide notes text that human-readable IG portions can specify conformance expectations, supporting this location for the restored clarification.
reconciliation: Added a focused paragraph to source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml stating that the publication form defines which artifacts are part of an implementation guide, that multiple representation formats of the same definitional artifact are equally authoritative, and that examples remain illustrative unless the implementation guide says otherwise.
source_changes: source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml: added a paragraph in the Roles of Implementation Guides section clarifying publication-form membership, equal authority of representation formats for definitional artifacts, and illustrative status of examples unless explicitly stated otherwise.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue added adjacent current ImplementationGuide notes text about human-readable IG narrative and conformance expectations, supporting the chosen current source location but not requiring a separate FHIR-18407 decision.
